title: Pathway-structured neural network improves survival prediction in DLBCL
summary: Cox-PASNet, a pathway-structured neural network survival model, was trained on 670 DLBCL patients (GSE181063) and fused transcriptomic with International Prognostic Index features. C-index was 0.700 in discovery and 0.732 in an external cohort of 233 R-CHOP-treated patients, versus 0.678 for IPI-Cox (difference +0.054, p=0.018). Adding cell-of-origin subtype raised it to 0.745 but not significantly. Explainability analysis highlighted apoptosis, hypoxia, IL6/JAK/STAT3 and interferon gamma pathways.
ai_technology: Cox-PASNet pathway-structured neural network with late fusion of transcriptomic and clinical features

evidence.tested: Discovery cohort of 670 patients and independent external cohort GSE10846 (n=233).
evidence.unknown: Retrospective public datasets; cell-of-origin gain was not significant; no prospective test; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Pathway-structured neural network models survival from gene expression and clinical features.
